page: Hetzner Cloud cax11 is an entry-level, cost-optimized virtual instance built on ARM64 architecture. Virtualized via QEMU, the instance is powered by an Ampere Altra processor featuring Neoverse-N1 cores operating at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz. The resource layout provides 2 shared vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with single-threading, alongside 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 1.95 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware-accelerated cryptographic processing is enabled via ARM AES instructions, whereas complex vector extensions such as AVX or AMX are not present.

Storage configuration includes a bundled 40 GB NVMe solid-state drive, providing low-latency local block storage directly attached to the virtual machine. The instance does not feature dedicated graphics hardware or included complimentary public IPv4 addresses, requiring reliance on IPv6 or an add-on IPv4 address for direct network routing.

Benchmark evaluations indicate modest computational throughput across synthetic and application-specific workloads. In stress-ng testing, single-core execution registers an average score of 1765.57, though multi-core throughput lands in the lower quartile at 3492.4 due to the shared 2-core footprint. PassMark tests confirm this baseline tier, scoring 1535.95 for CPU operations and 1281.01 for memory access. Application-level performance demonstrates 2.47 million operations per second in Redis SET routines, 2.11 GB/s in static web throughput, and 85.38 tokens per second on small 135M parameter language model prompt processing.

Due to its shared-core model and low resource profile, cax11 provides high cost efficiency for low-intensity continuous operations rather than computationally intensive deployments. The primary tradeoff lies between its economical price structure and reduced multi-threaded headroom or memory bandwidth. Hetzner Cloud cax11 is technically appropriate for lightweight microservices, development and testing environments, basic edge compute, modest API backends, and low-traffic web serving.
